name: Poslednij geroj: Luchshaja krazha.
source: An alternative story that tells about the fate of Maxim, who manages to get on the trail of a missing friend, and follow him into a strange world that we all already know about. But even once in the right place, the main character will have to try to meet Andrey face to face.
